title: Coins paired with tokenized stocks
summary: Coins from launchpads and projects that tie memecoins to tokenized stocks. STONK (StonkFun) says "Launch tokens / Backed by stocks", and @LaunchOnSF posted on 2026-10-16 that coins can now be launched paired with $MUSK4, a basket of TSLA, SPCX, NEURALINK and DOGE (e3:4). XSTOK says it lets users launch and trade tokens paired with stocks; @xstokfun posted on 2026-10-16 that xstok is open and pairs a coin with any stock on Raydium or Meteora (e3:3), and its pool was created about 14 hours before discovery. OTC says "Over-The-Counter Desks, earn stocks, pre-ipo, and yield", and @otc_labs posts daily revenue and the volume "across coins" ($98.33M on 2026-10-16, its own figure, e2:3). GTA VI (GTA6, StonkFun) says holders earn $TTWO stock by airdrop; a 2026-10-15 trader post counts 360K+ wallets receiving $31M of tokenized-stock rewards from Solana memecoins (e3:4). These are the projects' and traders' own claims: payouts, stock holdings and volumes are not verified, and no affiliation among the coins was checked. The Robinhood Chain stock-token coins (BORRO, IRIDIUS) and the AI-stocks meme BUBBLE are not counted. Measured: four coins across all their pools.

title: Launchpad and launch-tool coins
summary: Coins whose own metadata describes a launchpad or token-launch tool. Launch (LAUNCH, LaunchLab, Solana): "Launch launches coins on StonkFun, which runs on Raydium LaunchLab." RAYDIUM LAUNCHPAD (RAYPAD, LaunchLab): "A Launchpad the way it should be: no snipers, no copycats, and every fee burns your coin forever." Hooked (HOOKED, Meteora DBC): "Launch a token with rules built into the token itself. Solana runs the transfer hook on every trade." NTRNDM (created about 2026-10-10) and HOOKED (about 2026-10-03) are older than the LAUNCH and RAYPAD wave (18 and 3 hours old at discovery). Every description and fee-burn claim is the project's own; none is verified here, and the four coins are separate products with no shown link to each other.

title: GTA 6 Dacity Coin coins
summary: Coins named for Dacity Coin, an in-game meme coin that posts say appears in GTA 6 material. On 2026-10-11 the account @robtmb1 (RobTheMaster) posted that there is a meme coin in GTA 6 called "Dacity Coin" in a new leak (e4:0); the first Dacity Coin on pump.fun was created 35 seconds later (token created 2026-10-11 11:16 UTC, post at 11:15 UTC). A post of 2026-10-19 from the GTA 6 Intel account says DacityCoin appears on a stunt plane in GTA VI's launch trailer, a fictional crypto brand parodying real meme coins (e4:1). An automated claim check rated the claim "partly real" on 2026-10-18, saying the Dacity Coin name in GTA 6 material is real and widely reported but the leak timestamp and the leak's authenticity were not verified, and an earlier check on 2026-10-15 called it unclear (e4:0). Four coins carry the name: Dacity Coin (pump.fun, Solana; token created 2026-10-11), AudaCity (pump.fun; token created 2026-10-15 13:22 UTC), Dacity Coin (Pons, Robinhood Chain; created 2026-10-19 16:13 UTC) and GTAVI AudaCity (pump.fun; created 2026-10-20 04:04 UTC), whose metadata repeats the claim: "There's a meme coin in GTA 6 called \"Dacity Coin\" in the new leak." The other three have empty metadata, so their names carry the claim. Most posts about the coins are call-group promotion and listing-vote spam, and none of the coins is shown to be affiliated with Rockstar, Take-Two or the leak. These are traders' and the coins' own claims. Measured: four coins across all their pools.

_meta.presentationSummary: Coins named for Dacity Coin, an in-game meme coin that posts say appears in GTA 6 material. On 2026-10-11 the account @robtmb1 (RobTheMaster) posted that there is a meme coin in GTA 6 called "Dacity Coin" in a new leak; the first Dacity Coin on pump.fun was created 35 seconds later (token created 2026-10-11 11:16 UTC, post at 11:15 UTC). A post of 2026-10-19 from the GTA 6 Intel account says DacityCoin appears on a stunt plane in GTA VI's launch trailer, a fictional crypto brand parodying real meme coins. An automated claim check rated the claim "partly real" on 2026-10-18, saying the Dacity Coin name in GTA 6 material is real and widely reported but the leak timestamp and the leak's authenticity were not verified. Posts of 2026-10-24 (e1:6) repeat the claim in new words: one account says a clip shows a "CoinSide" trading app and that a plane with Dacity Coin branding appears in the launch trailer, another calls the coin an overhyped side-mission stunt promotion, and a third promotes a $GDC coin; none is an official source. Four coins carry the name: Dacity Coin (pump.fun, Solana; token created 2026-10-11 11:16 UTC), DacityCoin (pump.fun; token created 2026-10-15 13:18 UTC; added today on its name), AudaCity (pump.fun, symbol DacityCoin; token created 2026-10-15 13:22 UTC) and Dacity Coin (Pons, Robinhood Chain; created 2026-10-19 16:13 UTC). Their metadata is empty, so their names carry the claim. Most posts about the coins are call-group promotion and listing-vote spam, and none of the coins is shown to be affiliated with Rockstar, Take-Two or the leak. These are traders' and the coins' own claims. Measured: four coins across all their pools.
